_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Ozali Joueur {player_id}, ozali na {num_rounds} tours ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Ozali na ${pool} ya kusala matabishi yako na Joueur {other_id} oyo round.

Omobangi:
  - Tanga lokumu: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Soki ekweyi → Ozwi $(pool - X), mosala mosusu azwi $X
  - Soki ebimisi → Ndeko zote zwi $0
  - Exemple: [Offer: $3]  to  'Nalingi eloko oyo ezali na bokasi. [Offer: $5]'

Oyebi:
  - Sambaza lokumu na [Accept] to [Reject]
  - Exemple: 'Ezali na bokasi. [Accept]'
            'Ezali mabe mingi. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Mputu {round_number} ekosaka! ---
Mwana mboka {proposer_id} azali mpeki mbongo, Mwana mboka {responder_id} azali mpeki kozwa.
round.offer: Mputu {round_number}: Mwana mboka {proposer_id} abiki mbongo ${offer} na Mwana mboka {responder_id} (akoki ${keep}).
round.accepted: Mwana mboka {responder_id} ekweyi! Mputu {round_number} bazwi: Mwana mboka {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mwana mboka {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Jumla mpaya: Mwana mboka 0: ${total_0}, Mwana mboka 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Mwana mboka {responder_id} atikaki mbongo! Mputu {round_number} bazwi: Bana mboka zote +$0. Jumla ibaki: Mwana mboka 0: ${total_0}, Mwana mboka 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Omobangi azali na obligation ya kotanga lokumu na formati [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Motango ya lifuti esengeli kozala motángo mobimba oyo ebongi.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Motango ya mbongo esengeli kozala na kati $0 mpe ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Ezali na eloko moko te oyo tokoki kopesa ye.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Oyo akokaki azali na makasi ya kosekela to [Accept] to [Reject] lolenge.

outcome.win: Mwana mboka {winner} aboti na ${winner_total} kwa jumla, kasi na Mwana mboka {loser} aza na ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Tekisi! Bana mboka zote zikwi na ${total} kwa jumla.
